capabilities: Shows grey ghost-text suggestions for the rest of the current line
Accepts suggestions with Tab or word by word, dismisses with Escape
Sends requests to local LLM endpoints via LLM Endpoint Manager
Masks secrets like keys, e-mails and tokens before sending text
Excludes folders, files or notes from suggestions
extras: Desktop only; needs Obsidian 1.11.4+ for app.secretStorage keychain; settings reference and troubleshooting live in separate docs.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in inline completion that predicts how the current line continues while you type.

relations.evidence: endpoints, API keys and the model list come from the manager
A local LLM server with a model loaded, for example LM Studio.

summary: Inline ghost-text completion plugin that suggests how the current line continues, powered by a local LLM.
